what_this_is: The CURRENT deployment pins, in two blocks that are two different facts. `live` is what production serves: the deployment record's own numbers, moved ONLY by a deployment-authorization order. `source` is what a FRESH assembly of the committed source produces: moved by an application order, which puts source AHEAD of production until the next deploy. When the two agree, ahead_of_production is false and moved_by is null. Consumed historical authorizations are never restated here; they live in deploy/netlify/deployment_authorizations and are immutable evidence of what was authorized at the time (see supersessions.json).

live.note: Augusta, Georgia joined as the THIRTIETH market at 14 published profiles over 1 publishing corridor (Washington Road), built SHADOW_UNTIL_REGISTERED, registered against the Savannah-live parent as COMPOSITE_FRESH_MARKET_DATA_ONLY-shaped data (the automated narrow classifier could not grant a class for the eventual change set once Orlando then Tampa deployed independently on sibling branches and were merged in -- see founder packets 004/005 for the recorded structural reason), and founder-authorized on 2026-09-17 with all 63 unresolved identities HELD (routing/evidence/access-blocked/negation holds; the Hilton capability wall) and no identity_resolutions row written. The exact authorized artifact was deployed with no rebuild; the live sitemap hashes to the authorized candidate and all 2477 live routes return 200 (individually verified, not sampled), including every one of the 63 held identities confirmed 404 and both South Carolina spot-checks (north-augusta-sc, aiken-sc) confirmed 404. Rollback is the deployment Augusta replaced (Tampa-live, 29 markets), not that deployment's own rollback target.

source.note: A fresh assembly of the committed source produces exactly what production serves: the same bundle digest, from the same committed authority.
